body:
## What to build

Preserve ordinary R dots forwarding when a summary-local function passes a numbered dots argument to `pick()`. A selection that ordinary dplyr accepts must retain the same caller binding inside a Margin summary.

On main `4b34fdecb2d8a41034b3d9b5d5af8e51592555e1`, use a data frame containing x = 1:3. Define the summary value as an inline function with a dots formal, whose body sums `pick(..1)`, and invoke that function with x. Ordinary dplyr returns six; `summarize_with_margins()` instead reports that column `..1` does not exist. Forwarding all dots to `pick()` and forwarding the first dots argument to `across()` both succeed on the same Margin input.

A 504-case differential matrix found 288 Margin-only errors and 216 matching controls. The numbered argument was treated as a raw selection symbol instead of being resolved through the summary-local dots binding. Closed #1138 and its merged repair #1149 covered across/if_any/if_all; their bodies, comments and diff did not establish coverage of this remaining `pick()` boundary. No repair was attempted in this investigation.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A summary-local dots function forwarding its first or later numbered dots argument to `pick()` agrees with ordinary dplyr on the selected columns and summary value.
- [ ] Bare and qualified `pick()` calls, populated dots forwarding, named/unnamed summary output, and first/preceded summary positions retain the correct selection environment.
- [ ] Direct selections, all-dots `pick()` forwarding, existing across-family forwarding, and genuine missing-column diagnostics remain unchanged.
- [ ] Regression coverage exercises the public Margin call and compares it with the ordinary dplyr call, including an inline/local forwarding function rather than only an outer wrapper.

## Blocked by

None (can start immediately).

comments.body: The minimized replay, contract, expected/observed result, controls and duplicate comparison are retained in the [dated investigation evidence](https://github.com/sayuks/marginplyr/blob/9627abf5564d2f084f8c39700528fb51ee73a601/investigation/2026-11-03-summary-grouping-share-bug-hunt/summary/findings.md#f1-local-pick-first-dots-references-lost-promise-capture). The report mode passed and the desired-contract assertion mode failed on the investigated main snapshot. Investigation-only PR #1189 publishes the evidence; this issue remains open for the separate repair.
Implementation: #1192. The pull request contains the SHA-specific full verification and separate Standards/Spec review records.

title: [P2] Preserve numbered dots forwarding into summary-local pick()
